title: Black bean soup with soya yoghurt and avocado
steps: Dice the onion, garlic and pepper, sweat them in the oil for 5 minutes and briefly toast the spices.
Add the rinsed beans, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend about half of the soup and return it, then season with lime juice and salt.
Serve with soya yoghurt, diced avocado and coriander.
